name: [Dulcy Reply Agent] Reconcile delivery - NEVER SEND

parameters.query: WITH picked AS (SELECT job_key FROM dulcy_reply_agent.send_jobs WHERE workspace_record_id='recJx0WwHsdsvcVIN' AND reconciled_at IS NULL AND state IN ('claimed','unknown','submitted','sent') AND created_at < now()-interval '2 minutes' AND (last_checked_at IS NULL OR last_checked_at < now()-interval '5 minutes') ORDER BY last_checked_at NULLS FIRST,created_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE dulcy_reply_agent.send_jobs j SET last_checked_at=now() FROM picked WHERE j.job_key=picked.job_key RETURNING j.*;

parameters.jsCode: const j=$('Validate Recovery Job').first().json,ws=$('Read Recovery Workspace').first().json;if(ws.error||ws.id!==j.workspace_record_id||String(ws.fields?.ID)!=='2'||!ws.fields['EmailBison API'])throw Error('Recovery workspace unavailable');if($json.error||$json.records?.length!==1||$json.records[0].fields['Workspace Record ID']!==j.workspace_record_id)throw Error('Recovery settings unavailable');if(!j.approved_snapshot?.fields?.reply_message_id)throw Error('Recovery snapshot missing; manual reconciliation required');return [{json:j}];

parameters.query: UPDATE dulcy_reply_agent.send_jobs SET state=CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN 'sent' ELSE state END,last_checked_at=now(),reason=$3,updated_at=now(),reconciled_at=CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN now() ELSE reconciled_at END WHERE job_key=$1 RETURNING job_key;

parameters.jsCode: const d=$('Only Project Confirmed Delivery').first().json;if($json.error||$json.id!==d.recordId)throw Error('Recovery reread unavailable');const stable=v=>JSON.stringify(Object.entries(v||{}).sort(([a],[b])=>a.localeCompare(b)));if(stable($json.fields)!==stable(d.current.fields))throw Error('Inbox changed during recovery; preserve it');return [{json:{...d,updateBody:{fields:d.fields,typecast:false}}}];

const d=$('Preserve Concurrent Inbox Work').first().json;if($json.error||$json.id!==d.recordId)throw Error('Recovery write failed');const p=JSON.parse($json.fields?.['Dulcy Reply Agent Policy Decision']||'{}');if(p.lastConfirmedProviderMessageId!==String(d.job.provider_message_id))throw Error('Recovery receipt mismatch');return [{json:d}];

parameters.query: UPDATE dulcy_reply_agent.send_jobs SET reconciled_at=now(),last_checked_at=now(),reason='Confirmed delivery projected',updated_at=now() WHERE job_key=$1 AND state='sent' RETURNING job_key;
